_comment: Example nakon config — the VULN-PLANTING side. Each entry under `configurations` names a script in the vulndb catalog that, when deployed, makes the box INSECURE in a specific way. The huitz scenario awards points for hardening each one back. The agent picks which vulns go here (browse with `nakon catalog list --json`, validate with `nakon catalog check --config this-file.json`). The IP/user/password below are placeholders — at deploy time boxbuilder OVERWRITES them with the provider's address (see nakon.derive_deploy_config). v1 is single-box; the first machine is the one boxbuilder targets.
